show_table.description: Whether to show the table panel alongside the timeline. Pass null to clear.

table_properties.description: Property configuration for the table panel (when show_table is true). Pass null to clear.

preference.description: Timeline display preferences (zoom level and center position). Pass null to clear.

#/components/schemas/viewFilterRequest.description: Filter for the view. Uses the same format as the data source query filter (property filters, timestamp filters, or compound and/or filters). Simple property filters appear in the view's filter bar in the Notion UI. Select, status, and multi_select filter operators accept a single string or an array of strings to filter by multiple values (e.g. { "does_not_equal": ["Done", "Archive"] }).

type.description: Position type. "start" places the view as the first tab.
Position type. "end" places the view as the last tab.
Position type. "after_view" places the new view immediately after the specified view.

view_id.description: The ID of an existing view in the database. The new view will be placed after this view.

#/components/schemas/viewPositionRequest.description: Position of the new view in the database's view tab bar.

visible.description: Whether this property is visible in the view.

width.description: Width of the property column in pixels (table view only).

wrap.description: Whether to wrap content in this property cell/card.

status_show_as.description: How to display status properties (select dropdown or checkbox).

card_property_width_mode.description: Property width mode in compact card layouts (board/gallery).

property.description: Property name or ID to sort by.

#/components/schemas/viewSortRequest.description: Sort for the view. Can be a property sort (with property and direction) or timestamp sort (with timestamp and direction).

type.description: Placement type. "new_row" creates a new row containing the widget.

row_index.description: The 0-based row position to insert the new row at. If omitted, the new row is appended at the end.

type.description: Placement type. "existing_row" adds the widget to an existing row (side-by-side with other widgets).

row_index.description: The 0-based index of the existing row to add the widget to.

#/components/schemas/widgetPlacementRequ.description: Where to place the new widget in the dashboard. "new_row" creates a new row, "existing_row" adds to an existing row side-by-side with other widgets.
